questions.stem: Which of the following best describes a bias?

options.label: A
options.text: Random variation in data collection between exposure and disease

options.label: B
options.text: Systematic error in determining an association between exposure and disease

options.label: C
options.text: Measure of strength of association between exposure and disease

options.label: D
options.text: Direct estimation of frequency of exposure between disease and non-disease groups
